The CVE description states: "ip6erspan_changelink() was not converted ... and still uses dev_net(dev), which diverges from the device's creation netns after IFLA_NET_NS_FD migration." It also notes that "ip6gre_changelink() earlier in the same file already uses the cached t->net".
